label: RAID Log Reviewer
description: Systematically reviews and updates project RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies). Reassesses risk ratings, identifies stale items, and generates updated RAID register with management actions.

claudeKnowledge.description: RAID log management, project risk management (PMI, PRINCE2), risk assessment frameworks

guidedInputs.label: Project context
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Brief description of the project: type, stage, key milestones, and current status.
e.g. AMLR Implementation Programme, Phase 2 (Data & Systems), currently 60% complete. Go-live target: 1 September 2025.

guidedInputs.label: Current RAID log
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Paste your RAID log. Include: ID, Category (R/A/I/D), Description, Owner, Date raised, Last reviewed, Current rating, Status, and any notes.

e.g.
R-001 | Risk | Key IT architect may leave before go-live | CTO | 2024-10-15 | 2024-12-01 | High | Open
R-002 | Risk | Data migration quality insufficient for regulatory reporting | Data Lead | 2024-11-02 | 2025-01-15 | Medium | Open
A-001 | Assumption | AMLA technical standards finalized by Q1 2025 | PM | 2024-10-01 | 2024-10-01 | N/A | Open
I-001 | Issue | Vendor delivery delayed by 6 weeks | PM | 2025-01-10 | 2025-02-01 | Critical | Open
D-001 | Dependency | Data dictionary approval by Compliance Committee | Data Lead | 2024-11-15 | 2025-01-15 | Medium | Awaiting

guidedInputs.label: Recent project developments
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe any significant events since the last RAID review that may affect existing items or create new ones.
e.g. AMLA published draft technical standards last week. Key architect announced resignation effective 1 April. Data migration dry run completed — 3% error rate (threshold is 1%).

guidedInputs.label: Escalation threshold
guidedInputs.description: Which risk/issue rating triggers escalation to steering committee?
